# Parts

## Variables floe sets

| Variable | Set in | What it is | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--floe-room`, `--floe-copy-size` | The page's root | Two in a row | `0.75rem`, `30px` |
| `--floe-copy-room` | The page's root | The room for the button | `0px` |
| `--floe-inset` | A box's file | A shadow within | not set |
| `--floe-gone` | The page's root | Removed from the CSS | `1px` |
| `--tone` | An element with a tone | The tone's colour | — |

## Code's look

| Variable | Set in | What it is | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--floe-code-pad` | `code`'s root | The room at a line's sides | `1.1rem` |

The look styles `.lines`, `.names` and `.ghost` in a part, and `.lines pre` and `<code class="lines">` are not names alone.
